workflows.title: LiPo protection ON
workflows.summary: Enable Low-Voltage Detection before using a LiPo battery.
workflows.warning: Never use a LiPo battery while Low-Voltage Detection is disabled. On the XL-2.5, solid red means disabled; solid green means active.
steps: Turn on the transmitter and leave the throttle at neutral.
Connect the charged 2S LiPo battery and press EZ-Set once to turn the XL-2.5 on.
Check the ESC LED. If it is already solid green, protection is already active and you are done.
If the LED is solid red, press and hold the EZ-Set button. The LED will turn off.
Keep holding for about 10 seconds.
Release when the motor beeps twice and the ESC LED turns solid green.
workflows.result: Solid GREEN ESC LED = Low-Voltage Detection active (LiPo setting).

workflows.title: NiMH mode / LiPo protection OFF
workflows.summary: Disable Low-Voltage Detection when returning to NiMH.
workflows.warning: Only disable Low-Voltage Detection for NiMH use. Do not drive a LiPo battery in this mode.
steps: Turn on the transmitter and switch the XL-2.5 on.
Confirm the ESC LED is solid green.
Press and hold EZ-Set. The LED will turn off.
Keep holding for about 10 seconds.
Release when the motor beeps three times and the LED turns solid red.
workflows.result: Solid RED ESC LED = Low-Voltage Detection disabled (NiMH setting).

workflows.title: Training mode 50%
workflows.summary: Limit forward and reverse power to 50% while keeping full braking.
steps: Connect a charged battery and turn on the transmitter.
Leave the XL-2.5 switched off.
Press and hold EZ-Set. The LED goes solid green, then solid red, then starts blinking red.
Keep holding through the blink sequence and release immediately after THREE red blinks.
Wait for the ESC to finish the mode change.
workflows.result: Profile 3: 50% forward, 100% brakes, 50% reverse. Final LED remains green for LiPo mode or red for NiMH mode.

workflows.title: Return to full power
workflows.summary: Switch back from Training mode to normal Sport mode.
steps: Connect a charged battery and turn on the transmitter.
Leave the XL-2.5 switched off.
Press and hold EZ-Set until the red profile blink sequence begins.
Release after ONE red blink.
